content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Toptal : Professional Photoshop Artists Anywhere in the World California All Other Remote Contract <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6364/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.toptal.com/">https://www.toptal.com/</a> </p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Our client is building an open dataset of real, professional Photoshop work, published on HuggingFace under CC-BY-4.0, to evaluate how well AI systems understand creative editing. Not synthetic tasks. Not staged demos. Actual production work, done the way you already do it.</p> <p>We're looking for working Photoshop artists across six disciplines to complete client-style briefs while a screen recorder captures the session. You work from a brief, you open Photoshop, you do the job. Each task runs roughly 1–3 hours.</p> <p>Your process is the product here. The layer decisions, the masking approach, the moment you undo three steps and take a different route - that's exactly the signal this dataset is built to capture. If you've ever thought AI evaluation of creative work is shallow because the people building it have never actually retouched a beauty shot or built a matte painting, this is your chance to fix that.<br><br>Rate: $25/hr USD</p> <h3>Timeline:&nbsp;</h3> <p>This is an extremely urgent role with work starting immediately. If you are interested and apply, please expect to be contacted and requested to complete your account setup on September 9th (Friday), 10th (Saturday), or the 11th (Sunday) to be considered for this role.&nbsp;</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Complete Photoshop tasks from a client-provided creative brief, working at your normal professional standard</p> </li> <li> <p>Run a client-provided session recorder for the full duration of each task</p> </li> <li> <p>Deliver layered, production-quality PSDs along with final output</p> </li> <li> <p>Work independently, at your own pace, within the scope of each brief</p> </li> <li> <p>Contribute work that will be published openly for research use</p> </li> </ul> <h3>What You Bring</h3> <p>We're recruiting across six specializations and aiming for balanced coverage. Tell us which one is your home turf:</p> <ol> <li> <p><strong>Matte painting / digital environments</strong></p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Key visual / campaign compositing</strong></p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Game &amp; UI assets</strong></p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Print &amp; packaging pre-press</strong></p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Portrait / beauty retouching</strong></p> </li> <li> <p><strong>E-commerce / product retouching</strong></p> </li> </ol> <p><strong>Hard requirements - please read carefully:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or later)</strong> with your own licensed copy of Photoshop. Intel Macs and Windows machines cannot be used for this engagement.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Photoshop only.</strong> No Illustrator, Nuke, Blender, Procreate, or iPad workflows in the captured session.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>No generative AI of any kind</strong> - no Generative Fill, no Firefly, no third-party generative plugins. All work must be manually executed.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Individual contributor.</strong> No teams, studios, or subcontracted work.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Comfortable publishing openly</strong> under CC-BY-4.0, meaning the resulting work and session data will be freely available for anyone to use with attribution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrable professional portfolio in at least one of the six categories above.<br><br></p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-professional-photoshop-artists">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-professional-photoshop-artists</a></p> Fri, 11 Sep 2026 21:42:39 +0000 Sun, 11 Oct 2026 21:42:39 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-professional-photoshop-artists https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-professional-photoshop-artists GeoPro Labs Inc: Head of Operations - Shopify App Portfolio Anywhere in the World Product Contract <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Victoria, British Columbia, Canada <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://geoproapp.com">https://geoproapp.com</a> </p> <p><strong>The opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>I'm looking for an experienced operator to take ownership of a portfolio of three established Shopify apps with a combined ARR of approximately $1.87M.</p> <p>The portfolio includes:</p> <ul> <li>Geo:Pro: Geolocation-based storefront personalization</li> <li>TrackiPal: PayPal tracking automation for Shopify merchants</li> <li>Easy Lockdown: Content and storefront access control</li> </ul> <p>Together, these are profitable, well-established products with engaged customer bases. They're not hypergrowth startups, but well-run businesses with clear opportunities to improve the product experience, strengthen operations and continue growing over time.</p> <p>As the portfolio has grown, it's reached the point where I need an experienced operator to lead the day-to-day, keep the business running smoothly and turn strategy into execution.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role is fully remote, async-friendly and suited to someone who enjoys ownership, autonomy and building well-run businesses.</p> <p></p> <p><strong>What you'd own&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Team coordination and delivery: Run the day-to-day by coordinating the developer and tester through the full delivery cycle - from spec → build → ship → measure - keeping everyone aligned across time zones and hiring additional contractors as needed.</li> <li>Roadmap and prioritization: We'll set the roadmap together. I'll be closely involved at first, and over time this becomes increasingly your call. Turn Amplitude data, review themes and support signals into a prioritized backlog in Linear, and write clear tickets for the developer.</li> <li>Metrics and experimentation: Own the analytics story. Understand what moved, what didn't and what to try next. Design experiments and report on impact.&nbsp;</li> <li>Quality and documentation: Continually raise the bar on user experience through better documentation, smoother onboarding, fewer rough edges.</li> <li>Platform stewardship: Stay ahead of Shopify API changes, manage App Store compliance reviews and lead our annual Built for Shopify review to retain BFS status.</li> <li>Support oversight and escalations: Our support agency handles tier-1 tickets.
